purpose: Teach: 小笠原/手塚/工藤/テキサス/バスク/ヤクザ/弥生/ロッテ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが小笠原諸島に憧れてらした
lines.en: You know, Gran, when your father was young, he used to dream about the Ogasawara Islands.
lines.style: Soft, reaching back into memory. Gentle curiosity on the opening. Warm nostalgia. Let the name land. Slight pause before the island name—retrieving it from decades ago.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、手塚治虫の漫画を全巻お持ちだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear. And Grandpa had all of Osamu Tezuka's manga, didn't he?
lines.style: Warm correction-nostalgia blend. Small smile in the voice. Slightly teasing edge—she's testing his memory with something he might have forgotten. Affectionate.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんと工藤さんという旧友がいらした
lines.en: Gran, when he was younger, your father had an old friend named Kudo.
lines.style: Gentle return to the thread. Slower pace. Almost uncertain—wondering if she remembers this one too. The name offered carefully, as if checking.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、テキサス駐在のお話をよくされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear. Grandpa used to tell stories about his posting in Texas, didn't he?
lines.style: Light recognition. She's ahead of him now—remembering before he can fully say it. Warm amusement. A gentle 'I remember better than you do' quality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがバスク地方のワインを取り寄せられた
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father used to have Basque wine brought in special.
lines.style: Quieter now. The memory feels smaller, more intimate. Slower delivery. Let the Basque detail breathe—it's oddly specific, oddly dear.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ヤクザ映画は嫌いだと仰ってたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear. And Grandpa said he couldn't stand yakuza films, didn't he?
lines.style: Quick, knowing laugh underneath. She's caught him again—or the pattern of it. Light, almost conspiratorial tone. A wife's affectionate record-keeping.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが弥生時代の遺跡発掘に参加された
lines.en: Gran, when he was younger, your father even participated in excavations of Yayoi-period ruins.
lines.style: Wonder-struck on the 'even.' The most tentative of all—he's reaching far back now. Slight breathiness. Let it fade gently, unsure if this one will land.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ロッテの試合をよくご覧になってたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear. And Grandpa watched the Lotte games so often, didn't he?
lines.style: Fondest of all. Close, intimate whisper-quality. Eyes crinkling. The memory that makes her happy—she's done correcting him now, just loving the man she remembers.
